brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 补充的哪一边对，现在不必当场决定。
hint.en: Which side of Add alternative is right need not be decided on the spot any more.

t.zh: 对着「或者」，补充的左右两条规则都不会失败。<level-ref to="s-orelse"></level-ref>里，<part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref>只用第一个没失败的框，选错了也回不去。有了回溯，<part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref>也给出所有结果：先是第一个框的每一种，再是下一个框的每一种。
t.en: Against an “or”, neither of Add alternative’s two rules fails. In <level-ref to="s-orelse"></level-ref>, <part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref> took only the first region that did not fail, and a wrong choice could not be undone. With backtracking, <part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref> gives every result too: every one of the first region, then every one of the next.
